tasks.final_text: About an hour ago I spent my evening with a friend. Her name is Rachelle. We were able to get dinner, do work, and catch up on all the different jobs we are applying for post grad. The most interesting part of our night was talking about the different social constructs we participate in without being cognisant of it.
